description: Use when preparing for a Salesforce seasonal release — triaging release notes, reviewing Release Updates, opting into Sandbox Preview, and communicating change impact to stakeholders. Triggers: 'upcoming Salesforce release', 'release notes triage', 'Release Updates', 'sandbox preview opt-in', 'release readiness checklist', 'production upgrade date', 'feature impact', 'critical update', 'roll out the Spring release safely', 'is our org ready for the Spring release'. NOT for planning your own release train — use devops/release-management. NOT for user training and go-live comms — use admin/change-management-and-training.
inputs: Org edition and enabled feature areas (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Flow, Apex, etc.)
List of active automations, Apex code, integrations, and critical business processes
Sandbox inventory and which sandboxes are candidates for preview opt-in
name: salesforce-release-preparation
official_sources: Salesforce Help — Sandbox Preview Instructions (Knowledge Article 000391927): https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000391927&type=1
Salesforce Help — Upgrade Release Schedule FAQ (Knowledge Article 005224913): https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000005224913&type=1

Salesforce Help — Asynchronous Sharing Recalculation After Group Membership or Role Changes (Knowledge Article 005103630): https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=005103630&language=en_US&type=1 — confirms the Summer '25 introduction and completed enablement in all orgs in April 2026, that group and role changes still process synchronously, the Setup Audit Trail rows, the narrow scope ("Most group membership or role changes don't lead to asynchronous sharing recalculation"), and the "Update Apex Code and Flows for Changed Sharing Recalculation Behavior" release update (available Spring '26, enforced Spring '27). (verified 2026-08-13)

Salesforce Help — FAQs: Prepare for the Enforcement of the "Restrict User Access to Run Flow" Salesforce Release Update (Knowledge Article 001930084): https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=001930084&language=en_US&type=1 — confirms enforcement in Winter '26 after postponement from Winter '25, the deprecation of the FlowSites org permission, and that running a user-launched flow (screen or autolaunched) requires Run Flows (or Manage Flow) from a profile or permission set, while record-triggered, scheduled-triggered and platform-event-triggered flows are unaffected. (verified 2026-08-13)

outputs: Prioritized release notes triage list filtered by Feature Impact and relevant feature areas
Release Updates action plan: auto-activated vs. toggle-on items, enforcement deadlines
Sandbox Preview opt-in plan per sandbox with rationale
Stakeholder communication brief summarizing material changes and recommended admin actions
Release readiness checklist ready for sign-off
